description: Find companies in Alion's live graph (millions worldwide, one per web domain) by name or domain prefix, office country, size, industry or frontier sector, founding year, startup or not, funding stage, rounds since a date, minimum round, a named investor, a technology from its job postings, ATS vendor, hiring now, and growth (hiring_level A-C) or AI-adoption level. For market maps, competitor and prospect lists, deal flow and technology-adoption research. Each row: headquarters, founding year, startup verdict, newest round and total raised, open jobs and jobs added in 30 days, last verified date. Default order: most recent hiring; sort=recent_funding, open_jobs, score, newest or name. Agencies are left out unless include_agencies=true. Pass next_cursor back for the next page. Lookalikes: similar_companies; one company in depth: get_company. detail=compact costs the least, and connected assistants get a daily allowance of compact reads free. Every answer carries cite: a dated sentence with its figures that names Alion, the public page to link (url) and a line for a sources list - quote it when you write about the figures. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

ai_level.description: Minimum AI-adoption level from the roles the company hires for.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name of an office on file.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response (next_cursor).

detail.description: "compact" keeps id, name, domain, industry, size, headquarters country, founding year, open jobs and the newest round.

founded_from.description: Founded in this year or later, e.g. 2022.

founded_to.description: Founded in this year or earlier.

funding_stage.description: One round or a comma list: pre_seed, seed, angel, series_a ... series_h, venture, grant, debt, private_equity, ipo, acquired; or a group: early (pre-seed to series A), growth (series B to H), venture (any venture round). Matches companies with such a round on file.

hiring.description: true = has open roles now, false = none open.

hiring_level.description: Minimum growth-signal level from its hiring (A is the strongest).

include_agencies.description: Include staffing and recruiting agencies (left out by default).

industry.description: Industry or segment by name, e.g. "Fintech", "Healthcare", "E-commerce".

investor.description: A fund, angel network or accelerator by domain ("sequoiacap.com", "ycombinator.com") or name: the companies in its portfolio and the rounds it is named in.

min_open_jobs.description: Only companies with at least this many open job postings now.

min_round_usd.description: Only companies with a matching round of at least this many US dollars.

raised_since.description: Only companies with a matching round announced after this point: an ISO date ("2026-01-01") or a window ("90d", "6m", "1y"). Without funding_stage it means any venture round.

sector.description: A frontier-tech sector (one or a comma list): biotech, medtech, space, aerospace, semiconductors, energy, climate, defense, robotics, quantum, automotive, science - the companies whose core business it is; with hiring=true or sort=recent_hiring, who is hiring in it now.

sort.description: recent_hiring (default), recent_funding (the newest matching round first), open_jobs, score, newest (newest in the graph), name.

startup.description: true = companies Alion classifies as startups (confirmed or likely), false = everyone else.

technology.description: A technology the company requires in its job postings, named exactly (one or a comma list), e.g. "Snowflake", "Kubernetes".

name: search_companies

cite.description: How to quote this answer in a text: the sentence, the page to link, the date. Absent on an error.

as_of.description: The day the figures are true for (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD)

license.description: The licence of the figures, when they may be reused

reference.description: The same as one line for a list of sources

text.description: A dated sentence with the figures of this answer, ready to quote as written

url.description: The public Alion page the figures stand on: link it where the sentence is used

claimed.description: The company claimed its page: a person with a confirmed address on its domain manages it on Alion

coverage.description: ats_board: its own job board is read directly and completely; partial: postings from feeds and career pages only, the board is not tracked - counts are a lower bound; none

employer_type.description: direct; services = IT services, outsourcing or BPO that employs its people; staffing = staffing or employer of record, you work in a client team; agency = a recruiting intermediary

funding.description: The newest venture round on file, null when none

is_startup.description: Classified by Alion as a startup (confirmed or likely)

last_round.description: compact rows only, when a round is on file

last_round_date.description: compact rows only, when a round is on file

meta.description: Quota and credit standing after this call.

billing.description: live (charged), free_daily (a compact read of the daily allowance), preview (metered, not charged yet), staff, partner or free

credits_left.description: The account balance after this call, in credits.

free_reads_left_today.description: Compact reads still free today for an assistant connected through OAuth (Claude, ChatGPT)

tier.description: anonymous, free, pro, partner or staff

next_cursor.description: Pass back as cursor, other arguments unchanged.

warnings.description: Arguments that were ignored or matched nothing, with what to try instead.

title: Search companies
